title: US Passport Photo Requirements (Size/Pixels/Background) | Make Online
subtitle: 2x2 inches (51x51 mm), white background
description: Official US passport photo: 2x2 in (51x51 mm), head height 1 to 1 3/8 in, pure white background, captured within the last 6 months.

sections.heading: Size & Canvas
sections.body: Final output must be exactly 2x2 in (51x51 mm). At 300 DPI this equals 600x600 px; the State Department also accepts up to 1200x1200 px if the proportions stay square.

sections.heading: Head Placement
sections.body: From chin to crown the head should cover 50%-69% of the image height (roughly 25-35 mm). Keep both eyes visible, look straight at the camera, and maintain a neutral expression.

sections.heading: Background, Lighting & Attire
sections.body: Use an evenly lit, shadow-free pure white background. Avoid uniforms or camouflage patterns; everyday clothing is recommended. Glasses are not allowed unless accompanied by a signed doctor statement.

sections.heading: Digital File Checklist
sections.body: JPEG format, sRGB color space, file size between 54 KB and 10 MB. The photo must be in focus with no digital filters or over-retouching. Refer to the official guidance for edge cases.

tips: Choose the 2x2 in preset, enable auto crop, then use the alignment guides before exporting.
Turn on 'Background only' to quickly swap to pure white and adjust brightness if the face looks dull.
Need prints? Create a 6x4 inch layout and send it to a local photo lab for instant pickup.

title: Japan Visa Photo Size & Requirements | Make Online
subtitle: 45x35 mm, light/white background
description: Japan visa application photo: 45x35 mm, taken within 6 months, light or white background with clear facial features.

sections.heading: Dimensions & Resolution
sections.body: Target size is 45x35 mm. Exporting at 300 DPI yields about 531x413 px; online submissions commonly accept 600x470 px as well.

sections.heading: Background & Lighting
sections.body: Choose a plain white or light blue background. Avoid shadows around the face and neck; softly diffused lighting prevents glare on the forehead and cheeks.

sections.heading: Expression & Accessories
sections.body: Keep a neutral expression with mouth closed. Hair should not cover the eyebrows. Hats are not allowed and glasses are discouraged unless lenses are glare-free.

sections.heading: Print Submission
sections.body: When submitting paper copies, trim the print precisely to 45x35 mm. Attach with double-sided tape instead of staples to protect the surface.

tips: Select the 45x35 mm preset and use the 'Lighten background' slider if the original wall is slightly gray.
Enable face centering to automatically adjust eye-line height to the guideline zone.
Export both the single image and the 6x4 sheet—many visa centers request two identical copies.

title: 1-inch ID Photo Size (px/mm) & Background | Online
subtitle: 25x35 mm, ~295x413 px at 300 DPI
description: Standard 1-inch ID photo (25x35 mm) used for exam registration, resumes, and work badges. Supports rapid background change and DPI/file-size control.

sections.heading: Pixel Conversion
sections.body: At 300 DPI the 25x35 mm canvas equals roughly 295x413 px. For online forms that cap file size, reduce DPI to 200 while keeping the aspect ratio.

sections.heading: Common Use Cases
sections.body: China mainland exam systems (CET, postgraduate entrance), resume portals, and corporate HR systems frequently request the 1-inch format.

sections.heading: Background Colors
sections.body: White is the safest choice, but red and blue are often required for school admissions. Use the HEX picker to match institution guidelines exactly.

tips: Use 'Auto beautify' lightly (5-10%) to brighten skin without breaking official rules.
Tick 'Generate 6-inch sheet' to print multiple copies on one piece of photo paper.
For online uploads, set the target kilobyte limit in 'Export' to meet platform caps automatically.

title: 2-inch ID Photo Size (px/mm) & Background | Online
subtitle: 35x49 mm, ~413x579 px at 300 DPI
description: 2-inch (35x49 mm) ID photo widely used for passports, visas, and talent recruitment. Supports instant background swap and print-ready layouts.

sections.heading: Dimensions
sections.body: 35x49 mm corresponds to 413x579 px at 300 DPI. Keep the aspect ratio 7:5.88 when resizing to avoid cropping vital areas.

sections.heading: Pose & Framing
sections.body: Stand or sit upright with shoulders visible and head centered. Maintain a gap between the crown and the top border for natural breathing room.

sections.heading: Professional Presentation
sections.body: For interview or job portal use, choose a mid-tone background (blue or gray) and enable the sharpening slider below 20% to keep details crisp without halos.

tips: If exporting for print kiosks, choose the built-in 300 DPI profile to avoid blurry enlargements.
Use 'Face alignment' + 'Manual adjust' if the chin sits outside the guideline range after auto crop.
Switch to the resume-ready preset in the sidebar to store frequently used color/size combinations.

title: Change Photo Background to White (Online) | AI IDPhotos
subtitle: Auto matting, pure white background, one-click export
description: Upload a portrait, remove the original background, and replace it with studio-grade white in seconds. Ideal for passports, visas, and corporate portals.

sections.heading: When to Use
sections.body: White is the standard for most immigration, exam, and government IDs worldwide. A clean background avoids rejection caused by color casts or noise.

sections.heading: Workflow
sections.body: Upload -> select 'Background only' -> choose white (#FFFFFF) -> tweak feathering and shadows -> export PNG/JPG at the required DPI.

sections.heading: Quality Control
sections.body: Use the edge smoothing slider to eliminate jagged hairlines. The histogram preview helps keep skin tones natural after exposure adjustments.

tips: If the subject wore white clothing, add a subtle gray vignette (3-5%) so shoulders stand out from the background.
Combine with the 'Portrait whitening' tool at low strength to retain texture without over-editing.
Save the output as PNG when further background edits are expected; choose JPG for small upload portals.

title: Change Photo Background to Red (Online) | AI IDPhotos
subtitle: Auto matting and red background; HEX supported
description: Generate a compliant red background (e.g., #FF0000 or #D60000) for resumes, graduation dossiers, and regional ID cards.

sections.heading: Color Matching
sections.body: Select a precise HEX value or use the sampled color picker to match provincial or corporate specifications.

sections.heading: Balance & Contrast
sections.body: Increase exposure slightly so the face does not look dim against the saturated red. The AI keeps hair edges clean while avoiding bleed.

sections.heading: Printing
sections.body: After background replacement, enable the 6x4 layout and choose 'Borderless' when printing to maintain accurate margins.

tips: Turn on anti-shadow to soften harsh neck shadows that become obvious on red.
Use the batch export script (CLI) if you need to convert multiple employee photos in one go.
Pair with the 2-inch preset for mainland talent introduction programs that explicitly ask for red backgrounds.
